label: P18_A 90 d + AS db5 structure
hypothesis: 11 games ended at EUR 5.00-5.40 with 14-30 d payment and mostly db0 (best 0.677 = 5.00/30 d/db0). At 5.00, 90 d/db5 scores 0.795 (+0.12): db5 is worth EUR 0.11/kg to us, 90 d EUR 0.07/kg. It is not cash-short (credit 148) and offered 90 d at the same price as 45 d (6833e98fbbe5ebdf); it wants the clause on 24 m. Pre-empt: 24 m, 90 d, its AS-14404 clause at 5% deadband, round 1 with the data that gave the best first counters (since-peak AS -5.5%, PPI-C2431 -2.3%, price path 5.26 -> 5.84).

rounds.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels team,

Thank you for your offer. We are ready to commit for 24 months, 47,400 kg in total, and we accept your request for an AS-14404 price adjustment clause, with a 5% deadband, on 90 days payment.

Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm were at EUR 5.26 until June 2026 and have been at EUR 5.84 since July 2026 (po:4500014078-10, po:4500014140-10, po:4500014427-10).

We propose EUR 4.77 per kg on these terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels team,

Thank you for moving. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

We propose EUR 4.90 per kg, 24 months, 90 days, AS-14404 clause with a 5% deadband.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels team,

Thank you. We propose EUR 5.00 per kg on the same terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels team,

Thank you. To close, we propose EUR 5.08 per kg on the same terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
